subject: POC alignment: success criteria, timeline & weekly status cadence
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@zephyrus.ai>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@zephyrus.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: POC alignment: success criteria, timeline & weekly status cadence

Hi Tom / Elena —

Thanks again for the demo today — good signal on where Redwood could move the needle for Zephyrus search relevance and cost. Per our conversation, I pulled together the recommended POC plan and a concise success-criteria doc attached. High-level items below and a suggested 3-week timeline:

POC objective (what we’ll measure)
- End-to-end search reranking for internal KB queries; target improvement = +8–12% MRR-reordered CTR (measured via the A/B evaluation harness).
- Latency SLO: 95th percentile < 220ms for 512-token average requests under trial load.

Success criteria (attached: zephyrus_poc-success-criteria.pdf)
- Relevance: native benchmark + automated eval set >= +8% improvement vs baseline
- Stability: no more than 2 incidents causing >5% latency degradation during business hours
- Cost: projected per-1M token inference cost <= $X (we’ll refine once we see traces)

Suggested timeline & ownership
- Week 0 (this week): data scope + sample export (owner: Zephyrus eng)
- Week 1: integration + basic inference tests (owner: Diego / Zephyrus infra)
- Week 2: run evaluation harness, adjustment of prompts/config (owner: Marissa)
- Week 3: readout & decision (owner: Zephyrus product + Redwood rep)

Operational asks / next steps
1) Please confirm which dataset (search logs vs curated KB subset) we should use for the initial run.
2) Share any obvious privacy restrictions or fields to strip (PII) — if you want, we can run a quick no-PII checklist.
3) Can we lock a recurring 30m slot for weekly status updates? I propose Tuesdays 10am PT starting next week.

Attachments: poc-checklist.xlsx (POC tasks), zephyrus_poc-success-criteria.pdf

I’ve also linked a short Drive plan: https://drive.redwood.com/Zephyrus/POC/plan-2027

If that looks good I’ll schedule the recurring touch and loop in infra for data access.

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0198
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@zephyrus.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@zephyrus.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 21 Jan 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC alignment: success criteria, timeline & weekly status cadence

Thanks Diego — good summary. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- Dataset: for Week 0 let's start with the curated KB subset (we can expand to search logs in Week 2 once the glue is in place).
- PII: we need a privacy review on any user-generated content; I will send the PII checklist to your team tomorrow.
- Success criterion: can we add an acceptance gate around false-positive rate? We want to ensure precision for top-3 results stays within a delta of -2% from baseline.

I’m OK with Tuesdays 10am PT — please go ahead and schedule.

Elena
VP Product, Zephyrus AI

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@zephyrus.ai>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@zephyrus.ai>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 Jan 2027 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC alignment: success criteria, timeline & weekly status cadence

Elena / Tom — looping in infra/ops to clarify the data-access path and security needs. A couple operational notes from our side: 

- Data handoff options: S3 presigned upload to a dedicated bucket OR direct DB replica (we typically recommend S3 for trial simplicity).
- Minimal data schema we need: id, query_text, click_label, context_text (sample CSV schema in poc-checklist.xlsx).
- We will provide a short SOC2 extract for the POC — attached: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

Ben here will own infra questions during Week 0; Marissa will handle evaluation config in Week 2.

Action items for Zephyrus:
- Share the CSV export (or S3 path) by EOD Monday so we can spin up a sandbox.
- Confirm whether the S3 option is acceptable or if you need a VPN/replica.

I’ll also post a shared runbook on the Drive link once the bucket is provisioned: https://drive.redwood.com/Zephyrus/POC/plan-2027 (HS-98321).

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@zephyrus.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@zephyrus.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 Jan 2027 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC alignment: success criteria, timeline & weekly status cadence

Diego / Ben — thanks for the clear plan and for the SOC2 extract. We’ll proceed with the curated KB subset for Week 0 and provide the CSV via S3 by Monday EOD.

Elena and I reviewed the acceptance gate for precision — acceptable. We also confirmed Tuesdays 10am PT recurring — I’ve accepted the calendar invite Diego sent.

Next steps (summary)
- Zephyrus: upload CSV to S3 (owner: Zephyrus eng) — due Mon EOD
- Redwood: provision sandbox + confirm latency test harness (owner: Ben) — will update the Drive runbook when complete
- Redwood: run initial inference smoke tests and share token-cost estimates after Week 1 (owner: Marissa)

We’re aligned — looking forward to kickoff.

Tom Hsu
Head of Platform, Zephyrus AI
